source: Binance public OHLCV + CoinGecko public market chart + RSS headlines
history_note: OHLCV history goes back as far as each asset was listed on the exchange; not every coin has a full 10 years. Public CoinGecko endpoint may restrict long-range history on its free tier.

tradingview_ai.note: TradingView-style indicators derived from exchange candles; not an official TradingView export.

fundamentals_ai.note: Historical crypto market cap/volume/price proxies, not corporate financial statements.

news_ai.note: Recent RSS only; this is not a historical news archive and keyword features are a weak baseline.

order_book_ai.note: Historical snapshots require a real archive/provider. No historical depth is fabricated.

liquidation_ai.note: Historical liquidation events require a real archive/provider. No events are fabricated.
